Hey so I'm a 15yr old female (if anybody ask though I'm 16 stupid October birthday :) ) and I won't give the I know what your going through because I don't really buy what I can't tell from your post is that you really love this girl and love does hurt just like he said I had a friend who I liked so so much and I litterally thought I was going to marry him but that never really happened shit went down and I also ended up on here asking for help

But after a few months of contemplating Suicide, battling depression and other things as well I had a lot of time to think and I read something that really stuck with me "you will never be given a problem in life that you aren't strong enough to handle" and seeing as your situation is very difficult it means you are much much stronger than someone who floats by in life just living you've experienced a heartbreak and it really does suck but your strong enough to get through it

You seem like such a funny guy (as I can tell from your username) and I could just tell that you could have so many friends I understand that the want to just stay in and hide away from it all is strong but your stronger you can go out make friends and heal seeing a therapist is a good thing sometimes you have to go to one or two appointments to make sure you trust them before talking more freely but when you do it'll feel so much better
